newsitem.title: USA: Texas in settlement with U.S. Prudential. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Texas in settlement with U.S. Prudential. [CORRECTED 23:55 GMT]

text.p: The Texas department of insurance said it has reached a settlement with Prudential Insurance Co of America over allegations that the company used improper practices to sell life insurance.
Additional details were not immediately available about the settlement.
Texas was one of four states that had objected to Prudential's class-action settlement of consumer sales complaints.

Under the settlement, Prudential had agreed to pay at least $410 million to as many as 10.7 million policyholders who bought permanent life insurance between 1982 and 1995. (Corrects from "between 1982 and 1985.")
Florida, which had been one of the most vocal opponents of the class-action settlement agreed earlier Thursday to a separate multi-million dollar settlement with Prudential.
